description: This is a detailed medical chart of a patient. Following are the fields - Name, DOB, Sex, Phone, Address, Emergency Contact, Insurance Provider, Primary Care Physician, Weight (lbs), Height (feet and inches), Blood Pressure, Allergies, Medical History, Past Medications, Physician Notes

weight.instruction: weight of the patient in kilograms or kg. If the weight in specified in lbs convert to kg

height.instruction: height of the patient in inches

DOB.instruction: Date of birth of the patient

Emergency Contact.instruction: Emergency contact information for the patient

Insurance Provider.instruction: Health insurance provider for the patient

Primary Care Physician.instruction: Name of the patient's primary care physician

Weight.instruction: Weight of the patient in pounds

Height.instruction: Height of the patient in feet and inches

Blood Pressure.instruction: Blood pressure reading of the patient

Allergies.instruction: List of allergies the patient has

Medical History.instruction: Summary of the patient's medical history

Past Medications.instruction: List of medications the patient has taken in the past

Physician Notes.instruction: Notes from the patient's physician, including diagnosis, treatment, and prescriptions

vitals.instruction: Vitals of the patient I.E. weight, height and blood pressure
